title: Nyo (basket rattle)
summary: The nyo is an Igbo shaker, a woven basket rattle on a calabash base. Seeds inside the basket give a soft, wide rustle when it is shaken; the calabash gives a hollow thump when struck, and a tick sounds from its rim.
howToPlay: Three places are lit: Shake on the woven dome, Tick on the rim, Strike on the calabash base.
A ring closes on the place to strike. The basket trembles when it sounds.
Keep the strike on the beat and let the shakes fill the gaps.
rules: A stroke on the beat is perfect, a near one is good, and extra strokes cost points.
The round ends when the last stroke has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: In Igbo music the nyo keeps time, often in a steady dialogue with a pair of wooden clappers.
credits: Tradition: the nyo basket rattle; patterns written for this game
